advertisingRecharge.pageDescription: Submit advertising account recharge requests and review your own records. After finance pays, the amount is split by your share rate.
advertisingRecharge.financePageDescription: Review all advertising account recharge requests, record the actual CNY payment and payment screenshot. Payment is split into the applicant's and company fund accounts.
advertisingRecharge.searchPlaceholder: Search recharge no., ad account name or id
advertisingRecharge.financeSearchPlaceholder: Search recharge no., ad account or applicant

field.rechargeAmountHintCny: CNY by default; USD is available
field.rechargeAmountHintUsd: USD by default; CNY is available
field.paymentQrHint: Finance will pay with this QR code
field.paymentAmountHint: Split into the personal and company fund accounts by the applicant's current share rate

empty.ownHint: Use “New request” in the top right to submit the first recharge request
empty.allHint: Adjust the status or search conditions and try again

create.title: New ad recharge request
create.description: Fill in the ad account. Personal accounts also need a payment QR code.
create.pastePlaceholder: Paste ad account info, e.g. YN-QS-02 + 廣告帳號編號：2709967836064258
create.pasteHint: Supports “name + number” on two lines, or a bare account number
create.parseNumberOnly: Recognized number {no}; no account name found, please fill it in
create.parseNameOnly: Recognized name {name}; no account number found, please fill it in
create.parseConflict: Two different numbers found. Name comes from the first line and number from the labeled value; please verify.
create.parseFailed: No ad account information recognized. Paste it in the example format.
create.copyDescription: Copy the information below and send it to finance; finance opens the link to pay
create.closeUncopied: Not copied yet. Click close again to discard.
create.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select the text and copy manually.

detail.title: Ad recharge details
detail.financeDescription: Verify the request and payment QR code, then record the actual paid amount and payment screenshot
detail.paymentProofHint: jpg, png or webp only, up to 10 MiB
detail.paidHint: Payment is recorded in the fund ledger. To correct it, void the whole request with a reversal and submit a new request.
detail.rejectDescription: Rejecting closes the request without any fund movement. Please provide a reason for the operator.
detail.voidDescription: Voiding reverses the personal and company fund entries for the full paid amount and keeps the request history.

error.load: Failed to load ad recharge requests
error.loadDetail: Failed to load ad recharge details
error.submit: Failed to submit the ad recharge request
error.withdraw: Failed to withdraw the ad recharge request
error.reject: Failed to reject the ad recharge request
error.void: Failed to void the ad recharge request
error.noPermission: You do not have permission to view ad recharges
error.noPayPermission: This account cannot pay ad recharges
